gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.095885 42.309542)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 100 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH white_stadium AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-71.095885, 42.309542), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
dem_subset AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(rast, 1)).*
  FROM
    public.dem_us,
    white_stadium
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(rast, white_stadium.geom)
),
elevation_cells AS (
  SELECT
    val AS elevation,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_Point(x, y), 4326) AS cell_point
  FROM
    dem_subset
  WHERE
    val < 100
),
nearest_cell AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Distance(white_stadium.geom::geometry, cell_point::geometry) AS distance_meters
  FROM
    white_stadium,
    elevation_cells
  ORDER BY
    ST_Distance(white_stadium.geom::geometry, cell_point::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  distance_meters
FROM
  nearest_cell;
